correctness.rationale: Haar averaging over the entire coin sends the joint input to I_d/d tensor its position marginal before each shift, and tracing the shifted coin applies the one-step convolution channel on position. Independence justifies composition. After undoing the last controlled shift, the output is the fixed coin tensor the position channel at t=m-1. Fixed-coin input preparation and receiver postprocessing give equality of quantum capacities in both directions, including m=1 and for input states entangled across uses. Discarding the shifted coin instead gives t=m. In the character basis, phase-kick complement outputs only the input diagonal encoded into pure environment states; preserved output diagonals therefore implement the degrading map. Degradable single-letter coherent information is concave; Fourier-basis phases and character-label translations leave it invariant and twirl to I/N. At that input orthogonal regular translations give the environment eigenvalues p_t(g) and a maximally mixed system, yielding the exact stated capacity. Unit-modulus eigenvalues are only the trivial character and, exactly in the bipartite case, the unique parity character (the bipartition defines a homomorphism by word-length parity). Fourier inversion gives u_t uniform on the relevant support class from precisely these modes. Since u_t=h/N on C_t and p_t-u_t vanishes outside C_t, global Parseval yields E_{u_t}[(p_t/u_t-1)^2]=(N/h) times sum_g |p_t-u_t|^2=(1/h) sum of |lambda_chi|^(2t) off those modes. The zero-mean first-order entropy term drops out and the uniform O(r^t) perturbation gives a remainder O(r^(3t)); the M leading modes give M/(2h ln 2). If r=0 then p_t=u_t for t>=1. On the d>=3 cube the singleton and co-singleton characters give M=2d and a nonzero surviving coefficient at every finite t; for t=0 capacity is d, and d=2 saturates after t=1. Independent replay used exact entrywise coin recovery and integer walk counts on C3, C6 and K_{3,3} presented on Z/6; the first two high-precision normalized entropy gaps at t=28 approach 1/ln 2, and the last saturates exactly. This is a finite consistency test, not verification of the coding theorem.
residual_risks: Whole-channel unassisted asymptotic capacity; no observed coin draws, both output registers retained, fresh independent Haar coins. The entropy remainder and limit are for a fixed graph, not uniform across a family.

evidence: Brádler et al. supply the generic Hadamard/degradable framework, including the measure-and-prepare complement. Roofeh–Karimipour derive exact equal-block decohering capacities and obtain log2 k at complete interblock pinching; that covers the capacity of the limiting channel with k=h (a parity-dependent fixed translation at odd t is harmless). Caputo et al. compare worst-case KL and chi-square contraction constants, which are not the leading coefficient for the specified walk from a point.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Neither a general optimization principle nor a one-parameter equal-block or band-mask model gives the general finite-depth evaluated entropy law. For example, on a C5 walk at positive even t there are two distinct nonzero attenuating Fourier moduli, whereas the individual compared pinching or mask models have one common attenuating multiplier. The basic quadratic relation between entropy and chi-square is standard; the specific coefficient requires identifying the correct coset support and surviving eigenvalue multiplicities for this channel.

evidence: The limiting channel is pinching onto equal blocks of Fourier characters grouped modulo the peripheral character subgroup, up to output translation; the pinching capacity follows from known exact theory. The compared general-dephasing theorems do not select the maximally mixed optimizer for an arbitrary dephasing channel. The KL contraction bounds do not evaluate the exact relative-entropy deficit of the point-start periodic walk.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: No claim of new coding or entropy-expansion theory is warranted. What remains is the channel-specific final-coin equivalence with optimization using its character-shift symmetry, and conversion of the resulting noise law into the precise all-graph asymptotic, rather than simply substituting a graph size into the prior block-capacity formulas.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Persistent matrix entries or an averaged purity are not a quantum communication rate. The input-output equivalence after undoing the final controlled shift matters: the position-only channel has t=m, not m-1. Rephrasing dephasing or observing a -1 eigenvalue is not novel here.

value.rationale: The operational memory of the previously defined physical model is different from persistence of a matrix element, and the answer is needed at finite depths and with the correct receiver interface. The distinction between m-1 and m gives a concrete whole-step difference when the coin is retained, while the leading constant quantifies the excess above the established block-pinching limit on the fixed graph, including the canonical hypercube. This is a graph-wide quantified invariant, not just a demonstration of surviving parity modes or a direct reuse of one block's capacity.
residual_risks: No practical coding rates at finite blocklength, noise-robust implementation or joint graph-size/depth limit are established.
